levels.surface: أبي جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر

notes: «وبالإسناد الأول» opens the report; the 12 previous reports (prev1 to prev12) all open with a back reference and none writes its chain, so no inherited names can be taken: the phrase stands as written
«[عن جابر]» is in square brackets in the text; read as a link (Thaqalayn's English also gives «from Jabir»)
the Imam written inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his report of the Commander of the Faithful's conduct
